title: Cationic styryl dyes for DNA labelling and selectivity toward cancer cells and Gram-negative bacteria.
authors: Wangngae, Sirilak; Ngivprom, Utumporn; Khrootkaew, Tunyawat; Worakaensai, Suphanida; Lai, Rung-Yi; Kamkaew, Anyanee
one_liner_zh: 该文研究阳离子苯乙烯染料与DNA结合及细胞/细菌选择性，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是染料荧光标记应用，非TF-DNA互作机制或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Fluorescence-based methods are important tools for the analysis of nucleic acids in vitro and in cells. In this study, two cationic cyanine-styryl derivatives were produced using a two-step synthesis. Their optical properties were evaluated in different solvents, and frontier molecular orbital theory was utilized to interpret the findings. The DNA binding of these molecules was investigated to show fluorescence intensification. The molecular docking of both dyes in DNA illustrated the relevance of the electrostatic interaction between the quaternary ammonium of both dyes and the phosphate of the DNA backbone. Last but not least, applications of the synthesized styryl dyes were demonstrated to be selective towards cancer cells and particular kinds of bacteria.
abstract_zh: 基于荧光的方法是在体外和细胞内分析核酸的重要工具。本研究通过两步合成制备了两种阳离子花青-苯乙烯基衍生物。评估了它们在不同溶剂中的光学性质，并利用前沿分子轨道理论解释实验结果。研究了这些分子与DNA的结合，以展示荧光增强现象。两种染料在DNA中的分子对接表明，两种染料的季铵基团与DNA骨架磷酸基团之间的静电相互作用具有重要意义。最后但同样重要的是，合成的苯乙烯基染料被证明对癌细胞和特定种类的细菌具有选择性应用。
